name: Daniel H. Bromberg
title: Associate Justice, California Court of Appeal, Sixth Appellate District
district: Sixth Appellate District (Santa Clara, Santa Cruz, Monterey, and San Benito counties)
years_of_service: Sixth District Court of Appeal since January 13, 2023 (appointed by Gov. Gavin Newsom). (California Courts Newsroom)
background: Bromberg earned a B.A. in history from Yale and a J.D. from Harvard Law School. He clerked for U.S. District Judge Louis F. Oberdorfer (1990–1991) and for Judge A. Raymond Randolph of the D.C. Circuit (1991–1992). (Court of Appeal bio; Governor's office)

He practiced at Cahill Gordon & Reindel (1992–1994), Jones Day (1994–2005), and Quinn Emanuel (2005–2019), served as deputy legal affairs secretary to Gov. Newsom (2019–2021), and was a partner at Pillsbury Winthrop Shaw Pittman from 2021 until his appointment. (Governor's office)

Newsom nominated him in November 2022 to succeed Justice Franklin D. Elia; the Commission on Judicial Appointments confirmed him unanimously on January 13, 2023. November 3, 2026 is his first retention vote. (Governor's office; California Courts Newsroom)
